presets.name: Patient Case A: High-Risk Infiltrating Ductal Carcinoma Profile
presets.clinical_note: Fine-needle aspirate showing high nuclear pleomorphism, marked chromatin irregularity, and prominent concavity margins.

presets.name: Patient Case B: Typical Benign Fibroadenoma Profile
presets.clinical_note: FNA showing regular cohesive sheets, uniform nuclear diameter, intact myoepithelial cells, and minimal contour variations.

presets.name: Patient Case C: Atypical / Borderline Diagnostic Dilemma
presets.clinical_note: Intermediate nuclear enlargement with focal margin indentations; borderline risk requiring multidisciplinary correlation.

presets.name: Patient Case D: Typical Benign Cystic / Fibrocystic Change
presets.clinical_note: FNA demonstrating cohesive regular cells, low area/perimeter worst, and smooth contours consistent with fibrocystic change.
